## Summary

I changed the `customerCode` format to `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>` as specified.

**`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — reworked `nextCustomerCode`:
- Now takes both `city` and `lastName`.
- `CITY3` = upper-cased first three letters of the city; `LAST3` = upper-cased first three of the last name.
- `NNNN` is now a **per-city** 4-digit zero-padded sequence — one more than the number of owners already in that city (previously a global count), computed by filtering `findAllOwners()` on city (case-insensitive, matching the existing `equalsIgnoreCase` helper).
- Updated the call site and javadoc accordingly.

**`OwnerMapper.java`** — the `membershipNumber` (formatted `<customerCode>-M<YY>`) reads `owner.getCustomerCode()` directly, so it automatically rebuilds on the new format; I only refreshed its javadoc example (`MEL-SMI-0007-M26`) to match.

The acceptance test `coreCustomerCodeHasCityPrefix`, which asserts the code matches `[A-Z]{3}-[A-Z]{3}-\d{4}`, passes.
